svg.title: Aligned incident timeline, 8.4 minutes across three sources
svg.desc: Three lanes share a minute axis measured from the first event. The deploy lane marks the v2.4.1 deploy and the v2.4.0 rollback. The metric lane plots fourteen latency samples from 205ms to 705ms, with samples at or above the 470ms breach onset drawn in amber. The logs lane shows twelve events, sized and coloured by severity, including a burst of five ERROR entries. Dashed connectors show the three correlations the tool recorded: deploy to breach, deploy to error burst, and rollback to recovery.
